name: Prism Rack 1RU chassis (3 cards)
source: Teradek Prism Rack page and Prism 4K 1RU/2RU specs
notes: 1RU chassis for 3 Prism cards: 853 encoder (12G-SDI in + loop, 3.5 mm audio), 873 decoder (2 x 12G-SDI out), 877 Duplex (SDI or HDMI, encode or decode), server cards. Up to 15 W per card. Dual gigabit Ethernet. Add each card's connectors as extra ports. Check: which face cards load from, PSU inlets.

name: Prism Rack 2RU chassis (9 cards)
source: Teradek Prism Rack page and Prism 4K 1RU/2RU specs
notes: 2RU chassis for 9 Prism cards: 853 encoder (12G-SDI in + loop, 3.5 mm audio), 873 decoder (2 x 12G-SDI out), 877 Duplex (SDI or HDMI, encode or decode), server cards. Up to 15 W per card. Dual gigabit Ethernet, redundant power. Add each card's connectors as extra ports. Check: which face cards load from, PSU inlets.
